snippet.title: Official Reverie Steam Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist today and play the open playtest on October 16th https://store.steampowered.com/app/5298360/Reverie/.
The full demo is estimated to come out early 2027.

You can check out more info here: https://reveriegame.github.io/ReverieGame/

Join the Community! https://discord.gg/utUrugJ6C3
